title: ワガハイがテイオー先輩だ！

text_block_list.text: One day, I spot Tokai Teio in a slump.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Where did I go wrong?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well you see, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hey, Teio! I want to ask you something!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: A question? For me? Sure, I'll answer any and all queries you've got!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okay… I'll get straight to it. What is the secret to your strength, Teio?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you really don't beat around the bush. Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well… I ran in a scrimmage recently, but I wasn't happy with my performance at all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I wish I could get the crowds going like you do, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So I thought maybe if you could give me some advice, I could become a great runner like you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So, you think I'm great… I see, I see. And you want me to teach you the secret of my Teio tenacity?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I remember asking something like this once too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nah, just talking to myself. ♪ Hmmm, what did Prez end up telling me back then?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah! "Everyone possesses their own unique strengths, which through rigorous effort can lead them to greatness."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Uh… What?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And that's what happened. My speech had no effect on her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Everyone gets emotional when Prez says it, though…
choice_data_list: I think your own words might go down better.
I think your own words might go down better.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: My own words…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right. Thinking about it, Kita was inspired through watching my running.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Okay! Not sure if I'll sound as impressive as Prez, but…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll try speaking from the heart!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are! Heeey, Kita!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh… Teio?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sorry about earlier! I didn't understand what you were saying, but it's my fault! I should study harder…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No, I was the one in the wrong back there. All I did was copy Prez's words.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So this time, I've come to tell you the secret to my Teio tenacity, plain and simple. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All I can say is: don't give up on your dreams. No matter what knocks you down.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I made the choice to hold on to my dream and keep running with it. To never give in. And that's the secret to my Teio tenacity!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The secret is… to never give up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: T-Teio… I swear I'll become strong like you! I won't ever give up!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wow, just look at Teio… She's so cool.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I feel so inspired after hearing her words!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you see that? My juniors were totally admiring me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I was pretty cool if I say so myself! ♪ You agree, right? Wasn't I the coolest?
choice_data_list: Just as cool as the student council president.
Keep doing your best to earn their admiration!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Right? And I didn't even have to use Prez's words to inspire everyone! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But that's not the end of this! I need to work harder and surpass her!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll be needing you until then, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yup, yup! I've gotta work hard. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, I've got an idea! What about holding my very own lecture every day?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I must impart the teachings of my secret strength for all to know!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, why'd you go quiet? Something wrong with what I said? C'mon! Tell me, Trainer!
